prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Sign in with your original account to automatically restore your existing pet and desktop progress."]
2: ["Initializing Desktop Companion Engine", "Setting up desktop pet assets and rendering environment. This process takes up to 3 minutes."]
3: ["Choose Custom Pet Art Style", "Select a rendering style before uploading photos for optimal AI generation.", "Select Art Style"]
4: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is now active on your desktop. Right-click your pet or use the system tray icon to control, hide, or interact."]
5: ["Select Your Onboarding Journey", "Choose whether to adopt a pre-made pet companion or create a custom pet from photos."]
6: ["Certified Companion Founder"]
7: ["You can minimize this window. We will notify you as soon as your desktop pet is ready."]
8: ["Your Pet is Active on Desktop!", "Right-click your pet on desktop anytime to open quick controls, adjust behaviors, or minimize to the system tray."]
9: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Connecting your primary account ensures your companion, traits, and progress are backed up safely across devices.", "Please sign in using your existing account to preserve your pet."]

verdicts.problem: References a founder membership or paid tier status
